data.reasoning: This icon depicts a circled letter 'A' accompanied by sparkles. In modern software interfaces, this commonly represents an AI writing assistant, text auto-enhancement, or auto-correction features, combining 'A' for text/alphabet and sparkles for AI or magic. It can also metaphorically represent achieving a top 'A' grade. It is best used for tasks focused specifically on AI text generators or auto-correct settings, though it might be confused with a general 'magic wand' photo edit or 'auto' camera toggle outside of a tech context.
